create_FeatPCA: create a FeatPCA instance with a specified PCA dimension for feature dimensionality reduction
add_sample_FeatPCA: add a 2D feature array sample to the FeatPCA object for later PCA training
train_FeatPCA: train the FeatPCA model on all added samples and compute min max normalization bounds
transform_FeatPCA: transform a 2D feature array using the trained PCA and normalize output to 0 to 1 range
compute_feat_pca_from_renders: compute PCA models from rendered features of a scene using a list of VanillaGaussian models
